description.value: You were a digital avatar of some mortal design, spreading their message and sharing their ideas. You represent a club, company, team, or simply an idea brought to life. Your appearance might be based on the creature a sports team named themselves after, a piece of art that a particular museum is known for, a vehicle driven by a popular junkracer, or an abstract symbol chosen to represent an organization. You gain the Let Me Hear You Cheer action.
